questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui alerts Dr. Berrada about illegal practice. How many false dentists are practicing illegally in Morocco according to the ONMD?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'According to the ONMD, more than 3,300 false dentists practice illegally in Morocco.' Dr. Berrada: 'It's a real scourge.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada is concerned about the consequences of illegal practices. According to the ONMD, what are the dramatic consequences?
options: Deaths, permanent disabilities, and infectious diseases
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The ONMD denounces deaths, permanent disabilities, or infectious diseases contracted in deplorable hygiene conditions.' Dr. Berrada: 'We must act against this scourge.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui informs Dr. Berrada about draft law 25-14. What is its main objective?
options: Increase the fees for dental procedures
Protect legal practice and fight against usurpers
Modify the conditions of registration with the Order
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Draft law 25-14 aims to protect legal practice to remove usurpers.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will support this project.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada has heard about 'denture makers.' According to the ONMD, what is the main problem?
options: They receive patients for pseudo-medical treatments outside their authorization
They sell prostheses that are too expensive
They do not declare their income
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Denture makers receive patients for pseudo-medical treatments outside their authorization which is limited to manufacturing on prescription.' Dr. Berrada: 'We must denounce these practices.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the international impact of illegal practice. What reaction did the FDI have?
options: It expressed its indignation and supports the ONMD
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The FDI expressed its indignation in a letter to the president of the ONMD, supporting the fight against illegal practice.' Dr. Berrada: 'It's international recognition.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada is interested in the ONMD's actions. According to a study, what percentage of dentists consider it necessary to establish permanent control commissions?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: '76.3% of surveyed dentists considered it necessary to establish permanent control commissions.' Dr. Berrada: 'It's an overwhelming majority.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the role of the ONMD in the public-private partnership. According to Law 07-05, the ONMD organizes continuing education actions in coordination with:
options: Higher education institutions and scientific associations
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The ONMD organizes continuing education actions in coordination with higher education institutions and scientific associations.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will participate in these trainings.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about dentists' perception. According to a study, which aspect of the ONMD's management received the least satisfaction?
options: Control of the wording of professional nameplates
Organization of the continuity of care
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: '48.2% of dentists were dissatisfied with the control of the wording of professional nameplates.' Dr. Berrada: 'We need to improve this point.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the missions of the ONMD. According to Article 13 of Law 07-05, the ONMD fights against:
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The ONMD proposes and encourages any action aimed at fighting against illegal practice of the profession.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will support these actions.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada is concerned about the impact of charlatans. According to the ONMD, what is their discourse regarding draft law 25-14?
options: They are leading a disinformation campaign to have it amended
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Charlatans are leading a disinformation campaign to try to have the draft law amended.' Dr. Berrada: 'We must counter this disinformation.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the distribution of public dentists. What is the range of variation of the dentist/inhabitant ratio in Morocco?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The ratio varies from 1 dentist for 12,631 to 1 for 728,634 inhabitants depending on the region.' Dr. Berrada: 'It's a huge disparity.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada is interested in the fight against illegal practice. According to the ONMD, what types of premises are particularly targeted?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Premises known as denture makers are particularly targeted.' Dr. Berrada: 'We must strengthen controls.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains Morocco's ambition. According to the ONMD, what is the Kingdom's ambition in dental health?
options: Become a reference medical center in Africa
Be content with training dentists for the local market
Reduce the number of dental medicine faculties
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Morocco aspires to become a reference medical center in Africa.' Dr. Berrada: 'It's a noble ambition.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about the role of dental prosthetists. According to the ONMD, what is their legal authorization?
options: They can receive patients for consultations
Their authorization is limited to the manufacture of prostheses on prescription from the dentist
They can perform medical acts in their laboratory
They are authorized to place implants
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The authorization of prosthetists is limited to the manufacture of prostheses on prescription from the dentist.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will remind this rule to my patients.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the embassy alerts. Why did some embassies issue alerts to their nationals?
options: To warn them against the risks of care in unapproved establishments
To criticize the Moroccan health system
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Some embassies have issued official alerts warning against the risks of care in unapproved establishments.' Dr. Berrada: 'It's a serious alert.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada is interested in the missions of the ONMD. According to Law 07-05, the ONMD gives its opinion on:
options: Draft laws and regulations concerning the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The ONMD gives its opinion on draft laws and regulations concerning the profession.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will follow the ONMD's opinions.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the impact of charlatans on Morocco's reputation. What is the risk for medical tourism?
options: Morocco risks losing its credibility in dental care
Tourists are attracted by low prices
Morocco is praised for its fight
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Illegal practices harm Morocco's image and its ambition to become a reference medical center.' Dr. Berrada: 'We must protect this image.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about disciplinary sanctions. According to the ONMD, what are the possible sanctions for a dentist?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The sanctions are warning, reprimand, suspension, and striking off.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will scrupulously follow the rules.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the role of the legal advisor of the ONMD. According to Article 36 of Law 07-05, what can they do if the National Council exceeds its powers?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The legal advisor requests the president to submit the decision to a second deliberation.' Dr. Berrada: 'It's a procedural guarantee.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada is interested in social welfare. According to the ONMD, the Order contributes to the creation of works of:
options: Social welfare for the benefit of dentists
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The ONMD contributes to the creation of social welfare works for the benefit of dentists.' Dr. Berrada: 'It's an important advantage.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the constitution of Regional Councils. According to Article 38 of Law 07-05, a Regional Council is created when the number of dentists reaches:
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'A Regional Council is created when the number of dentists is equal to or greater than 400.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will inquire about my Regional Council.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about the ONMD elections. According to Article 20, who can vote in the National Council elections?
options: Moroccan dentists registered with the order and up to date with their dues
Dentists with more than 10 years of experience
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Voters are Moroccan dentists registered with the order and up to date with their dues.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will update my dues.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the duration of mandates. According to Article 22, members of the National Council are elected for:
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Members of the National Council are elected for four years.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will follow the elections.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about the accumulation of mandates. According to Article 22, can a member of the National Council combine with a position on the Regional Council?
options: Yes, if elected in two regions
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'They cannot combine the functions of member of the National Council and Regional Council.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will choose my commitment.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada, after having explored public health issues with Dr. Cherkaoui, receives his congratulations. What is the next step for Dr. Berrada?
options: Become an expert in public health and in the fight against illegal practice
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Mastery of public health issues is a valuable skill. Becoming an expert is the next step.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will commit to the fight against illegal practice.'
